cards.heading: The inheritance route now has a ceiling, and it stays closed
cards.narration: Overnight, we audited 4 published papers equation by equation, then derived the missing inheritance limit ourselves. This is Duho's personal side-interest, not a NebulaMind research programme. Under the published homogeneous-bounce reading, the strongest defensible ceiling leaves the best sky signal roughly 10,000 to 100,000 times below even counting every observable galaxy. The inheritance route now exists on the record as a ceiling, and it says the route stays closed: nothing observable.

cards.heading: The published chain testifies against its own bounce
cards.narration: Act 1 begins with the chain. Its 4 papers produce 77 audit rows. The later bounce paper says the earlier spin-fluid foundation is “not self-consistent” and “violates the cosmological principle.” That is the paper's own verdict, not ours. 1 treatment uses repulsive stiff torsion and a smooth turning point; the other uses an attractive Dirac correction with a cusp-like velocity jump. They are incompatible mechanisms, not 1 bounce.

cards.heading: The 2 bounce treatments disagree by about 730
cards.narration: Re-derived separately, the 2 treatments disagree by about 730 on bounce density. Both calculate classically at or above the Planck scale, where classical theory is unestablished. This is no small parameter choice: 1 branch reaches a smooth halt before re-expanding, while the other has positive effective energy at its minimum and requires a prescribed jump. Any result that says “the bounce” without naming the branch hides the central fork.

cards.heading: An underived averaging choice swings torsion by exactly 6
cards.narration: The shared number has another fork. Both papers square the total fermion density, but neither derives that choice. Coherent versus independent species changes torsion density by exactly 6. The published value reproduces near the coherent edge; the better-motivated independent edge is 6 times smaller. We carry a bracket instead of selecting the endpoint, and every later result keeps that unresolved assumption attached.

cards.heading: The unread erratum is replaced by recomputation, not guesswork
cards.narration: The journal record confirms an erratum exists, but no permitted host exposes its content. We quarantined 3 printed numbers and recomputed them. 1 honest caveat: the erratum's content remains unread behind a paywall, so our recomputations stand in its place, and the strict chain awaits external theorist review before any publication claim.

cards.heading: The strict chain begins where the published spin bridge ends
cards.narration: Act 2 begins where print stops. Mass maps exactly into the interior's initial size, temperature, and angular extent, but parent spin has no published transfer function. Torsion couples to fermions' intrinsic spin, not a black hole's orbital angular momentum, so it cannot carry parent rotation alone. The published papers leave that vorticity-transport problem through the bounce unsolved. We bounded the missing bridge without inventing one.

cards.heading: Causality caps inherited spin near 1 part in 10 to the power 27
cards.narration: Demand the published homogeneous bounce of a rotating 10-solar-mass parent. If all parent angular momentum reached the bounce, rotation would overshoot the causal limit by a factor of 6.6 times 10 to the power 26. Self-consistency leaves at most about 1 part in 10 to the power 27, with the treatment branches spanning roughly 1 order of magnitude. Under Reading 2, rotating collapse never reaches this homogeneous solution at all; what happens instead remains underived.

cards.heading: The bounce performs zero ironing-out
cards.narration: Next, we tested whether the bounce could erase lopsidedness. Shear and torsion dilute at exactly the same rate, so their ratio is frozen. A bounce occurs only when shear is already subdominant; the bounce itself performs zero ironing-out. It cannot create an axis memory and it cannot erase it. Survival remains undetermined because the only proposed eraser is particle production, and that step is heuristic rather than derived.

cards.heading: Every generous confrontation still lands below every floor
cards.narration: Our torsion-density bracket sits 45 orders of magnitude below the published nucleosynthesis bound. That means consistency, not detectability. Then we stacked every generous choice for an axis signal. The treatment branches leave only about 10 to 100 parts per million of the perfect all-galaxy counting floor. That floor means counting all 2 trillion observable galaxies; it is a theoretical best, not an instrument. Conserving angular momentum directly makes the signal vastly smaller still.

cards.heading: The ceiling answers the axis question: nothing observable
cards.narration: We did not prove BHU cosmology false, and we did not test the wider family. We audited 1 published Popławski chain, kept its unresolved limits visible, and replaced its missing inheritance claim with the strongest ceiling its own homogeneous bounce permits. The frozen ratio supplies no hidden axis memory, and the all-galaxy floor leaves no observational escape. Asked through this published chain, the axis question answers: nothing observable. The strongest inheritance route now exists on the record as a ceiling, and the ceiling says the route stays closed.
